children: fell 1.9% in Monday's trading as Barclays downgraded the utility company to Equal Weight from Overweight with a $48 price target, trimmed from $52, saying the stock has priced in progress on the Oklahoma RFP and the greater likelihood of growth-rate acceleration after the state rate case.
has a strong catalyst path, but it is almost entirely priced into the stock's current multiple, which has re-rated compared to utility peers, Barclays analyst Nicholas Campanella said.

The analyst said he folded in ~$3B in additional capital spending to the current plan, representing execution of the near-term pipeline while still arriving under consensus expectations for estimated 2027-30 earnings per share.

"We are assuming positive outcomes and value the stock at a 12.5% premium to its small-cap peer group and still see limited upside from the current price, which explains our downgrade," Campanella wrote.

title: OGE Energy downgraded at Barclays as catalysts likely already priced in
